evidence.tradeJournalRole: immutable plan-time allocation/stop ledger used by Portfolio Risk Tier-A reconstruction

risk: A same-date rerun or asymmetric write/update can leave Shadow score provenance and journal allocation rows with matching scanDate+symbol but no cryptographic/immutable proof they came from the same decision generation.

safeScope.allowed: Within-Shadow prospective PriorityScore ranking/component analysis that does not require journal allocation join, subject to its existing cohort/coverage rules.
safeScope.guarded: Cross Shadow↔trade-journal sizing attribution and any promotion claim that depends on score provenance being the exact generator of the persisted allocation.
safeScope.forbidden: Treat scanDate+symbol equality alone as shared-generation proof for Formal promotion.

engineering.classA: Document/classify generation certainty using existing fields.
engineering.classBProposal: Add a shared immutable scan generation / decision fingerprint to both research snapshot and journal plan persistence, with exact-date readback and mismatch fail-closed.
engineering.classC: No Formal decision behavior change is implied or authorized.
